description: Continues an open webinar conversation by exactly one turn: pass what the host said as `text` and get the reply with the next tappable choices. Side effect: the answer is stored in the conversation state (facts, flow position) for `session_id`; nothing is written to a WordPress site and nothing is sent to anyone. Needs `session_id` and `text`. The reply carries `flow` ({ jetzt, weiter, auch, chips }) with the next choices; on the next call the open `flow.jetzt` goes into `flow_step` and the chosen chip's label into `flow_choice`. A reply with ready=true means the texts can be written next with `wi_write_webinar_texts`.

flow_choice.description: which chip the host tapped, EXACTLY as its label read in the returned `flow.chips` (or the label of an own option). The server advances the flow from this.

flow_step.description: the flow step that was open in the previous answer — copy it from the returned `flow.jetzt`. It tells the server where the conversation stands so it does not have to guess.

flow_strecke.description: the route (Strecke) that runs — copy it from the returned `flow.strecke`. It tells the server which route to follow so it does not fall back to the default.

known_facts.description: Everything you already know — send it every turn so nothing is lost on a restart. On the FIRST call (this call or this call) this is how a chat/assistant hands over what it already learned about the host (topic, audience, offer, style/tone) instead of making them repeat it.

language.description: The language the host writes in.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

text.description: What the host said (thema · weiter) or the question in the host's language (frage).

name: wi_continue_webinar
title: Continue a webinar conversation
